text: Planning a trip is exciting, but it also takes time and effort. You need to choose a destination, book tickets, and pack your bags. When you travel, you meet new cultures and try delicious food you have never tasted before. Sometimes you face language barriers, which can be difficult, but people often help you with a smile. These moments teach you patience and understanding. After the trip, you return home with wonderful memories that stay with you forever. Travel not only opens your eyes to the world but also helps you grow as a person.
